mapper.select: SELECT * FROM learning_units WHERE stage_id = #{unitId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_units (stage_id, title, type, external_url, platform, author, duration_minutes, description, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{title}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceUrl}, #{sourcePlatform}, #{author}, #{duration}, #{description}, #{orderNum}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_units SET title = #{title}, type = #{resourceType}, external_url = #{resourceUrl}, platform = #{sourcePlatform}, author = #{author}, duration_minutes = #{duration}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{orderNum}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM learning_units WHERE type = #{resourceType} AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM learning_units WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
